name: agentfit
description: Office-work routing layer for PPT, research, reports, data analysis, project management, product design, PRD, roadmaps, proposals, meeting notes, and document tasks. Automatically decomposes the task and discovers relevant Skills, MCP servers, plugins, and installable projects before execution.

interface.shortDescription: Office task decomposition and component discovery
interface.longDescription: For everyday office and knowledge work, AgentFit decomposes the task, generates search keywords, automatically researches GitHub candidates, and asks before installation or execution.
capabilities: GitHub Skill, MCP, and plugin discovery
defaultPrompt: For office tasks (PPT, research, reports, data analysis, project/product planning, proposals, meetings, documents), automatically use AgentFit to decompose the task and discover components before execution.
Use $agentfit when automatic activation is not selected; it will search GitHub candidates and ask before installation.
